damage.name: damage
params: amount,a|number|1|The amount of damage to deal
ignoreArmor,ia,i|boolean|false|Whether or not to ignore armor, but will still use enchantment modifiers when calculating total damage
preventknockback,pkb,pk|boolean|false|Whether or not to prevent knockback
preventimmunity,pi|boolean|false|Whether or not to prevent the damage immunity ticks on the target by setting them to 0 after the damage is inflicted
damagecause,dc,cause|string|entity_attack|Sets the damage cause for this damage mechanic. (This option is only available for 1.17+)
ignoreenchantments,ignoreenchants,ie|boolean|false|Whether or not to ignore enchantments when calculating total damage. (This option is only available for 1.19+)
noanger,na|boolean|false|Whether or not to generate anger when damaging the entity
ignoreinvulnerability,ignoreinvulnerable,ii|boolean|false|Whether or not to ignore the damage immunity ticks on the target by setting them to 0 before the damage is inflicted
ignoreshield,is|boolean|false|Whether or not to ignore the shield blocking on the target
damageshelmet,dh|boolean|false|Whether or not the helmet should be damaged
ignoreeffects,ieff|boolean|false|Whether or not effects should be ignored
ignoreresistance,ir|boolean|false|Whether or not resistance should be ignored
poweraffectsdamage,pad|boolean|true|Should the skill's power affect the damage inflicted
tags,tag|string||Allows you to specify any number of arbitrary tags for the mechanic using tags=THIS,THAT. All tags inserted will be UPPERCASED
rawtags,rtag|string||Works the same as tags and what is put here will also qualify as a tag, but it will not be UPPERCASED like tags
damagetype,element,e|string||Becomes one of the Tags
triggerSkills,ts|boolean|false|Whether the damage mechanic should also be able to trigger onAttack related triggers
bonusdamage|string||The bonus damage to deal, in the format FIRE 5,LIGHTNING 5
bonusdamagemodifiers,bonusdamagemods|string||Multiplies the associated bonus damages by the specified values

modifydamage.name: modifyDamage
params: amount,a|number|1|The amount of the operation
damagetype,type,dt,t|string|ALL|The type of the damage to evaluate
action,mod,m|string|ADD|The modifier to use

consume.name: consume
params: damage,d,dmg|number|1|The amount of damage to deal
heal,h|number|1|The amount of healing per mob damaged

skill.name: skill
params: skill,s,$,(),m,mechanics,meta,spell|skill||The metaskill to be executed
forcesync,sync|boolean|false|Whether to force the skill to be run synchronously with Minecraft
branch,b,fork,f|boolean|false|Whether the called metaskill skill tree branches off from the calling skill tree
executeafterdeath,continueafterdeath|boolean|false|Whether the metaskill can be called after the caster dies
snapshotcasterstats,snapshotstats,scs|boolean|false|Whether caster stats are snapshotted when the skill executes
